speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Three trenchers, and the board is clear. If you are going to talk of court, talk before the pottage skins.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I had it from a Carey groom, come down from Richmond. I will tell you what happened. I will not tell you what the street has added since.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then tell the part with a groom in it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: On Monday the Queen showed my lord of Essex a book. He came out pale. He has kept his chamber since. That is the part a man can vouch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the book itself?

speaker: george_bryan
text: It is called A Conference about the Next Succession. Put out over sea, under a name that is said to hide a Jesuit's. Whose name, I do not know. The talk knows more than the groom, and I will not pretend otherwise.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: There's a man endangered by praise he never asked for. Say where you heard it, Master Bryan, and I'll know how much to believe.

speaker: george_bryan
text: From the groom, and only this. The book is dedicated to my lord. It runs through Lancaster, and the second Richard, for its precedents. What is now told of his private feelings grows more confident every time it is told, and has no groom to vouch for it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Precedents. Since Monday. Two days, and the tale is already fatter than any book I have held.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody at Paul's had seen it. I am not going to see it by talking at this board.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Then do not. I have three mouths here, and a kitchen that can hear through a door. I will believe the groom. I will not believe a feeling that walked in by itself.

speaker: george_bryan
text: That is the division. What happened. What is being told. I keep them apart, or I am no use to a supper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Since Monday, George. Say it again so the kitchen gets the short version.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Since Monday. And fatter since, yes. I will not feed it.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: There. The first sensible thing either of you has done is to say nothing a kitchen can repeat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in the aisle this morning. It was louder than the stalls. The book was not in the aisle.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we eat. I am not spending a supper on a patron I have not seen.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Eat. If you are asked where you heard it, say a groom, and say no further.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: I will say Master Bryan said a groom. That is as far as my credit goes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Far enough. I am not matching it with anything of mine.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Some books are other men's. This one can stay other men's.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A name on a front leaf is not a part a man played. I have said that once. I will not decorate it.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Then let him have his chamber, and let this house have its pottage. I am clearing trenchers if you are done being careful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are done being careful.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Done, and unquoted.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Unquoted is how a careful man leaves a supper.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Then leave it. Three trenchers were enough mouths for one rumour.
